from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace')
for name in ('AGENTS.md', 'next-env.d.ts'):
    path = root / name
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), path
    path.unlink()

build_info = root / 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'

    assert build_info.is_file() and not build_info.is_symlink()
    build_info.unlink()

build_dir = root / '.next'
assert build_dir.is_dir() and not build_dir.is_symlink()
assert {child.name for child in build_dir.iterdir()} == {'dev'}
shutil.rmtree(build_dir)
